questions.question: When Jesus came and stood among His disciples in a locked room, what did He show them?

answers.text: The linen cloths from the tomb

questions.question: After the other disciples said they had seen the Lord, what did Thomas say he needed before he would believe?

answers.text: To see and touch His wounds
To hear the Lord's own voice

questions.question: When Jesus appeared to Thomas and told him to stop doubting, what did Thomas say to Jesus?
Why were the signs of Jesus written down for people to read?

answers.text: So you may believe and have life
So the temple keeps a record
